coaching_findings.title: State mutations described without business rules
coaching_findings.why_it_matters: Specifying operations like update, delete, or cancel without state guards leaves business constraints undefined, leading to untested invalid state transitions.
coaching_findings.suggested_improvement: Define state preconditions: e.g. 'Customers can update an order while in the pending state. Once shipped, the API must reject modification requests.'

coaching_findings.title: Negative cases and error handling omitted
coaching_findings.why_it_matters: Specifying only happy-path behavior leaves validation, conflict handling, and auth rejections untested. Production code must handle malformed data and edge cases.
coaching_findings.suggested_improvement: Identify key failure scenarios: 'Reject malformed inputs (422), unauthenticated requests (401), foreign resource access (403), missing resources (404), and duplicates (409).'

coaching_findings.title: Verification and automated testing treated as an afterthought
coaching_findings.why_it_matters: A specification without automated verification expectations cannot be verified deterministically. Agents may produce plausible code that fails under real execution.
coaching_findings.suggested_improvement: Specify test expectations: 'Include automated integration tests exercising the actual API routes and database persistence, covering both authorized happy paths and unauthorized negative cases.'

coaching_findings.title: Completion criteria and definition of done undefined
coaching_findings.why_it_matters: Without observable completion criteria, coding agents may declare success after generating stub code or partial files rather than fully executing tests in a clean environment.
coaching_findings.suggested_improvement: Define observable completion conditions: 'The work is complete when the application starts cleanly, database migrations execute, and all automated pytest tests pass.'

- COMP-004: the full pytest suite passes with zero failures

- no pagination beyond a simple limit/offset

coaching_findings.title: Negative cases and error handling omitted
coaching_findings.why_it_matters: Specifying only happy-path behavior leaves validation, conflict handling, and auth rejections untested. Production code must handle malformed data and edge cases.
